facts.business: Pasari Spinning Mills Limited was engaged in manufacturing cotton yarn but has discontinued manufacturing operations since July 2011 and currently rents out its former factory building.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Promoters planning to enter retail industries

auditor.name: M/s Rao & Emmar, Chartered Accountants, Bangalore (Firm Registration No. 03084S)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter on: (1) Going concern uncertainty due to legal dispute with Cotton Corporation of India and execution proceedings; (2) Property, Plant and Equipment carried at nominal values without revaluation; (3) Unpaid property tax since FY 2019-20 with provision of Rs. 18.87 lakhs; (4) Rental income classification in cash flow statement; (5) Contingent liability of Rs. 18,016.07 thousand for tax demand; (6) Discontinued manufacturing operations and rental arrangement accounting; (7) Provision of Rs. 63.90 lakhs and contingent liability of Rs. 639.22 lakhs for Cotton Corporation of India dispute.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to legal disputes with Cotton Corporation of India
Execution proceedings and proclamation of sale on immovable properties
Contingent tax liability of Rs. 18,016.07 thousand under KVAT/CST Act
Dependence on rental income from former factory building
General economic conditions and textile industry downturn
Socio-political risks including labor laws and natural calamities
facts.related_party_note: Rental income of Rs. 11.08 lakhs adjusted against security deposit of Rs. 12.71 lakhs received from GreenPro Nettings Pvt. Ltd., resulting in balance deposit of Rs. 1.63 lakhs at year-end.
